title: Veridical-to-illusion calibration-transport barrier
result: A frozen channel calibrated where target and cue are co-aligned does not identify the illusion target. In the declared binary family, source-discordant calibration, selector transport and orientation transport are jointly required and jointly sufficient.
selected_target: H_tip (experience-internal distal contact location); not basal experience, report, or conceptual self
next: Test whether a same-participant held-stick localizer can make actual contact P and nuisance sequence cue C disagree while retaining a warranted H=P anchor and a prospective context-blind selector/pole transport test.
